overview_description.description: As data became excessive and abundant, Quant was established as a Saudi consultancy company to provide services such as Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Artificial intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Quality Management, and Analytics Training, Predictive Analytics, as well as AI & BI SaaS products. At Quant, we empower aspiring businesses and dynamic governments to become data-driven through our offered services, which allows them to optimize operations, enhance efficiency, and augment decision making.

product.name: QI (Quant Intelligence)
product.description: An AI-powered SaaS platform providing real-time location intelligence for strategic site selection, market expansion, and location optimization.

product.name: Fruits360
product.description: A POS-integrated software delivering business intelligence and analytics for restaurants to optimize sales, inventory, marketing, and operations.

product.name: Quant Enterprise AI-powered Models
product.description: AI and machine learning models for real estate and retail sectors, including property valuation, building detection, forecasting, and customer segmentation.

product.name: Location Intelligence Tool
product.description: A multi-layered platform combining geospatial data and AI to support smarter site selection and market analysis in Saudi Arabia.

product.name: Advanced Analytics Solutions
product.description: Customized business intelligence and analytics solutions for F&B, retail, and other sectors to unlock operational insights and growth potential.
